caption: The drawing depicts three blue flowers with stems and leaves, arranged in a small cluster and painted in varying shades of blue. The flowers have rounded petals and are surrounded by a brownish, textured background. Above the flowers, there is black stenciled text that reads, "2 W A MACQUOID & CO. POTTERY WORKS." Near the upper right corner, there is a blue line drawing of a jar with a lid, featuring the same text and an image of the flowers shown on the main part of the drawing, indicating a label or design for pottery. The artist's signature, "JOHN TARRANTINO," appears in the lower left corner of the image. The entire drawing has a sepia-toned, slightly aged look, with color primarily consisting of browns, blues, and blacks.
title: Jar
